bio: I'm a Junior Software Engineer focused on building modern full-stack applications that connect clean user experiences with reliable backend systems, cloud-native architecture, and practical AI-powered features.

My work spans frontend development, backend APIs, microservices, DevOps practices, CI/CD workflows, and AI integration. I care about maintainable code, clear architecture, automated delivery, and software that is easy for teams to improve over time.
focus: I'm looking for junior software engineering opportunities where I can contribute to full-stack products, cloud-native systems, DevOps automation, and AI-enhanced developer or user workflows.
